authority: V2 identity lock identifies this unchanged shipped crop as the approved identity seed. The owner-supplied two-view character image sets the current quality and costume-shape target. Neither reference approves the V3 candidate.
owner_supplied_visual_direction: Use the silver-haired fantasy swordsman with bronze armor, ivory tunic, mustard-gold scarf/cloak, leather details, and sharp one-handed sword shown in the latest owner-provided images. Match its crisp linework, clear material separation, and large readable character presentation. Use open Ragnarok repositories and per-file licensed assets as practical visual references for drawing and asset separation; reuse source art only where the applicable license permits it, and keep Astraeon's master artwork original.

locks.face: Youthful male storybook warrior; keep eyes mostly concealed beneath swept bangs.
locks.hair: Short tousled silver/lavender-grey hair with broad swept fringe; no redesign.
locks.costume: Bronze/gold armor over a split ivory tunic, dark olive/navy underlayers, teal waist detail, tall dark boots, leather belts and gloves, plus the mustard-gold scarf and long cloak shown in the current visual reference. The default beauty render wears the cloak; BackAccessory is a fully separate optional cosmetic with a clean no-cloak variant.
locks.weapon: Straight narrow one-handed steel sword with warm bronze/gold hilt in anatomical right hand.
locks.style: High-detail, crisp 2D fantasy RPG illustration at the owner reference's level of edge clarity and material definition: readable hair locks, clean face planes, carved armor seams, layered leather, cloth folds, metal reflections, and a sharp sword edge. Draw at maximum clean source resolution for reduction to the 160px runtime cell. Use legally reusable Ragnarok art only as a reference or source where its license permits. Avoid blur, low contrast, airbrush haze, noisy texture, fuzzy edges, photorealism, plastic sheen, and direct tracing of unlicensed pixels.
locks.camera: Preserve V2 elevated game-sprite perspective and locked framing.

animation_direction.naturalism: Keep human joint mechanics, balanced weight, readable foot contacts, and consistent weapon grip; avoid stiff or comic motion.
animation_direction.idle: Sword-ready stance with quiet breathing and a small, believable weight shift.
animation_direction.walk: Natural alternating footfalls, steady torso, and relaxed sword arm; no exaggerated marching.
animation_direction.basic_attack: Energetic, controlled fantasy low diagonal sweep with anticipation, wind-up, torso and hip weight transfer, clear contact, continuous sword arc, follow-through, and return to guard. Add a bright, tapered gold-white sword trail and compact impact glint on a separate effect layer. Avoid deep forward bows, flailing, stiff wrist-only waving, or toy-like swings.
animation_direction.back_accessory: Golden scarf and cloak are present in the default visual configuration but live entirely on an independently toggleable BackAccessory layer. Keep a no-cloak configuration with no holes or pose/framing changes.

paint_consistency.authoring_workflow: Paint one complete full-character master from the approved motion guide, then cut per-frame labelled layers from that exact master; never paint the layers as independent sheets.
paint_consistency.source_motion_authority: Keep the existing approved action, direction, camera, frame order, root, and timing. Cutouts inherit the master frame coordinates without independent transforms.
paint_consistency.combat_effect_layer: CosmeticFX; transparent and separate from the sword, character, and equipment layers
paint_consistency.sheet_layout: 8 directions as columns, chronological frames as rows; each part is cut from the matching full-character master frame and retains its exact canvas, root, and pixel registration
paint_consistency.concealed_surface_policy: Exact cutouts preserve visible master pixels. Before enabling a swap, paint concealed BaseBody surfaces under hair, outfit, and accessories so replacements never reveal holes.
paint_consistency.current_owner_reference_policy: Latest two owner-supplied images set crispness, outfit, and cloak direction; they do not constitute approval of the generated candidate
paint_consistency.provider_policy: Mocap Online motion renders are guide data only. No AI provider may receive those assets without prior written permission from MoCap Online.
